I am a white arctic fox with green eyes sporting a lab coat, a purple scouter, and mechanical arms on my back. As of right now I have progressed the most out of every species in existence in terms of civilization. Right now I strive for one thing and one thing only, Perfection. What that is I won’t say in this file just in case some entities find this file. 

  

Species: Vulbes Lagopus

  

Abilities: (well I don’t really have much other than my will to progress, but I will put things that I typically use in here) My scouter is top of the line, allowing me to get any surface data on an entity and store it in a file. The scouter can also detect any wavelength so entities can’t hide from me. I also have 8 mechanical arms on my back that allow for easy traversal across any surface. Though they might be lightweight due to blackhole holds changing their density to be the same as steel, should these be turned off they weigh about the same as a neutron star. Each arm has a blue circle at the end that allows for a variety of effects, such as electricity, fire, etc. The strongest effect they currently have is the ability to extract an entity's essence from their body, turning them into a husk. And of course I have my machines to not only automate everything but also to extract as many resources as possible.

  

Current status: currently I’m getting closer and closer towards Perfection. I just can’t get enough condensed energy into the machine, even using an entire universe for power is just not enough. (sigh) I’ll have to look at more universes for the answer, though this new one my scouts have found does seem interesting. The energy appears to be extremely chaotic so it might be worthless but who knows what I might find.
